name: Media Organizer 1.5.2
body:
**Real-desktop validated release.** The full app flow was driven end-to-end on the real running application (not just simulations): folder picking via the native dialog, suggestion chip, strategy selection, live plan table, filtering, dry run (verified zero writes), real organize (23 files into 15 folders, duplicates skipped, uncertain dates set aside), and undo (everything restored). 28/28 checks passed.

One small fix found during the drive: the status bar after a dry run now correctly says "nothing was written".

179 automated tests + 131 QA scenario checks, all passing.

Download **MediaOrganizer-Setup-1.5.2.exe** below.
